kjv: thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself
mine: you shall be profaned by your own doing
note: venihalt is most naturally the Niphal of halal "be profaned" (as in 22:26 "I am profaned among them"); KJV derived it from nahal "inherit", which gives an unusual sense here. Context: you shall be profaned (Niphal of halal) (medium confidence). Venihalt is best taken as the Niphal of halal 'be profaned', as in 7:24 (venihalu) and 22:26, matching the shame of exile in 22:15; most modern versions agree. The ancient versions derive it from nahal 'inherit, possess', mostly with God as subject, so another sense remains possible. Other possible meanings: (1) 'you shall take your inheritance in yourself' — KJV (nahal); (2) 'I will take possession of you' — LXX, Vulgate (possidebo), reading a first-person verb from nahal; (3) 'I shall be profaned through you' — NRSV, first person with halal (cf. 20:9, 14).
